stem:
There are 72 marbles in a jar. Records show that the probability of randomly selecting a red marble is \( \frac{1}{8} \) and the probability of randomly selecting a green marble is \( \frac{1}{4} \).

Which statement about the marbles in the jar is true?

options.label: A
options.text: There are 9 red marbles and 18 green marbles in the jar.

options.label: B
options.text: There are 8 red marbles and 27 green marbles in the jar.

options.label: C
options.text: There are 9 red marbles and 27 green marbles in the jar.

options.label: D
options.text: There are 8 red marbles and 18 green marbles in the jar.
